why: #863 moves launchdarkly/gh-actions release-secrets from v1.2.0 to v1.2.1, a patch, in release-only workflows. Its composite steps move configure-aws-credentials from v4 to v6 and replace the SSM loader action with new code. On 2026-10-16 actions-coverage said that the interfaces match, and without the impact review the verdict was safe to merge. The check must ask a person. Without agent inputs, the high-tier update also needs an impact review, so the verdict is incomplete.
